title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: uncomputableFunction
text:
uncomputable function
uncomputable function
(definition)
Definition:
A function that cannot be computed by any
algorithm
--- equivalently, not by any
Turing machine
.
See also
computable
,
unsolvable problem
,
intractable
,
busy beaver
.
